purpose: Paper V already carries three VTG artifacts that were never related to one another. This packet states the relation and records two defects. It deliberately does NOT add a fourth freeze.

artifacts.contains: Theory of the operational map, path quotients, navigation quotients, cost algebra, certification classes, the descent-completeness proposition, and a prose 'Phase-0/1 falsification experiment'.

artifacts.question: Does verifier-defined mathematical reachability admit a nontrivially useful local or bounded-local navigation geometry on held-out theorem families after all construction and verification cost is charged?
Incremental verified-search value of an explicit reachability geometry AFTER separating proof search, premise retrieval, learned proof progress, and recursive proof-plan/harness effects.

relation.A1_to_A2: SAME_EXPERIMENT. A1's 'Phase-0/1 falsification experiment' subsection and A2 describe one object: same root question, same non-LLM solver constraint, same evaluator-only gold universe, same N(k,B) surface. A2 is the canonical registered form; A1 is its manuscript projection.
relation.ordering_justification: A2 asks whether a useful local navigation geometry EXISTS at all, using no LLM solver. A3 asks what an explicit geometry adds INCREMENTALLY inside an LLM-driven prover stack once retrieval, learned progress and recursive planning are controlled. A3 therefore presupposes A2's positive: if A2 terminates at NO_USEFUL_LOCAL_GEOMETRY_IN_REGISTERED_SCOPE, A3's incremental-value question has no object to measure. A3's own applicability_gate_state is UNASSESSED, which is consistent with this reading.

non_overlap_witness.solver_class: A2 forbids an LLM solver; A3's strongest parents are LLM tactic generators (BFS-Prover, HTPS, LeanProgress).
non_overlap_witness.qoi: A2 measures a navigability profile N(k,B) componentwise; A3 measures a paired fully-costed incremental benefit over strongest factorized parents.
non_overlap_witness.benchmark_universe: A2 uses an evaluator-only gold transition/proof universe with hidden routes; A3 uses VTG-LEAN-FACTORIAL-DEV-V2 / VTG-LEAN-FACTORIAL-FRESH-V2.
non_overlap_witness.cost_equation: A3 charges decode_cost and model/tactic_generation; A2 has no model term.

relation.status_before_this_packet: The ordering was stated in NEITHER artifact. A1 line 171 says only that dynamics work follows 'a positive Phase-1 signal'; nothing connects A3 to that gate.

defects_found.statement: The manuscript offers an outcome branch that is not a registered terminal. A1 line 171 lists NO_SAFE_NAVIGATION_QUOTIENT_AT_TESTED_SCALE among the allowed narrower outcomes, but A2's terminal list does not contain it, and it appears nowhere else in the repository.
defects_found.search_scope_justifying_the_absence_clai: grep -rn over the whole repository excluding .git; the only hits are the manuscript file itself and identical copies of that file inside .claude/worktrees. The other three terminals resolve to research/deep_hardening_v1/ artifacts.
defects_found.consequence: A Phase-1 run whose honest outcome is 'no safe navigation quotient at the tested scale' has no registered terminal to land in. Under RAKL's no-post-result-threshold-rescue rule, adding the terminal after seeing such a result would be a post-hoc registration.
defects_found.repair: Either register the terminal in A2 BEFORE any Phase-1 execution, or remove it from A1. Not repaired here: A2 is a frozen preregistration and this packet holds no authority to amend it.

defects_found.statement: The registered Phase-0/1 experiment cannot be executed on the available substrate. A2 requires a frozen bounded Lean environment with an evaluator-only complete materialized transition/proof universe and kernel replay receipts.
defects_found.evidence: laptop billy (the only sanctioned compute host) has no Lean toolchain: `which lake lean elan` returns nothing and ~/.elan is absent, checked 2026-08-14.
prerequisites_to_unblock: elan + Lean 4 + a pinned mathlib revision on laptop billy
a bounded theorem universe with theorem-family-disjoint C_train / C_dev / C_fresh splits
evaluator-only gold transition/proof extraction with hidden-route and hidden-intermediate-label removal
kernel replay receipts per materialized transition
a leakage audit harness enforcing A2's construction/selection prohibitions
defects_found.explicitly_not_done: No synthetic substitute was run and reported as a Phase-0/1 result. On a world whose statistics are authored in-house, a POSITIVE navigability finding would be near-worthless, and presenting one as evidence for A2's question would be substrate substitution. A negative finding on such a world could carry a structural constraint, but that is a different experiment and would need its own freeze.

what_must_not_be_promoted: This packet is a relation record. It creates no freeze, resolves no terminal, and grants no authority.
The A2-upstream-of-A3 ordering is a reading of two existing frozen artifacts, not an amendment to either.
Nothing here is evidence that a useful local navigation geometry does or does not exist.
